app.title: Choose an Object
app.description: Three objects and the details that make them extraordinary.
app.experienceSummary: where selecting one of three invented objects opens its details inside the app.

hero.alt: Invented terracotta vase, bronze mirror and cobalt bottle on ivory plinths.

pages.title: The terracotta vase
pages.body: Clay becomes a vessel through pressure, water and heat. Follow the carved leaves around its warm surface. This object is an invented illustration for our local demo.

pages.title: The bronze mirror
pages.body: A circular face catches the light. The green patina gives this imagined bronze piece its quiet depth; turn your attention to the birds and branches.

pages.title: The cobalt bottle
pages.body: Deep blue glass becomes almost black in shadow and electric at the rim. Notice how the rounded body gathers and bends the gallery light.
